create.title: Exact squarefree-kernel coefficient and target-safe large-square reduction
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), C(m)=sum_(hr=m,r odd,r>4h)chi_4(r), k_m=floor(sqrt(Nm)+1/2), and j_m=k_m^2-Nm. Write m=s t^2 uniquely with s squarefree. If gamma is the common part of sf(h),sf(r), then C(st^2)=sum_(gamma|t, gamma squarefree, (gamma,s)=1, gamma odd)chi_4(gamma) sum_(de=s,e odd)chi_4(e) sum_(ab=t/gamma,b odd,e b^2>4d a^2)1. Equivalently, with G=(h,r), C(st^2)=sum_(de=s)^ord sum_(Gab=t,(da,eb)=1,Geb odd,e b^2>4d a^2)chi_4(Ge). Both formulas are multiplicity one and retain every 2-adic case. On each literal half-open block I_M=N intersect [M,B_M), B_M<=2M, the aggregate t>=T has absolute price <<_(epsilon,V)X^epsilon M^(1/4)/T. Hence the Round-144 scalar is target-equivalent to the same masked scalar restricted to t<M^(1/4), where s>M^(1/2), with the t>=ceil(M^(1/4)) complement O_(epsilon,V)(X^epsilon) after dyadic assembly. The retained signed scalar is not estimated.
create.next_action: Prove the fixed-centre individual complex estimate for the exact small-t, large-squarefree-s survivor, or produce a further strict owner-complete reduction. Retain both coefficient parametrizations, the mask, profile, terminal endpoints, and Pell geometry.

create.title: Bounded-t capacity, exceptional-frequency, and source obstruction
create.statement_tex: On the exact small-t survivor, the available divisor-envelope upper price of a t-shell is M^(1/4)T^(-1)X^epsilon, and the isolated t=1 layer has upper capacity M^(1/4+o(1)), reaching R^(1/2+o(1)) at M asymp R^2. It receives no cancellation from the t-variable, while C(p)=chi_4(p) for odd primes p>4 proves nonvacuity only. The large-displacement mask does not uniformly separate sqrt(Ns): for squarefree s>1 and X=N=sL^2+1, sqrt(Ns)=sL+rho with rho=(sqrt(L^2+1/s)+L)^(-1), and while t rho<1/2 one has k=sLt, j=-st^2=-m, and e(t sqrt(Ns))=e(t rho). With L=s there is a literal profiled small-t retained range with t rho tending to zero. Thus no uniform frequency-gap or bounded-partial-quotient inference is valid. No audited theorem accepts the exact coefficient, mask, growing centre, and individual direction at target power; even favorable separated Sargos-Wu leaves R^(2/5+epsilon), and Robert-Sargos leaves R^(1/2+epsilon) or R^(3/4+epsilon). These are upper-bound limitations, not signed lower bounds or a disproof of the target.
create.next_action: Park t-only geometric-sum cancellation, uniform partial-quotient assumptions, complete-divisor substitution, linear-squarefree substitution, and direct use of the audited monomial bounds. Reopen with a genuinely signed cross-s or joint s-t theorem for the exact coefficient.

Exact radicals remain separately target-safe, but the N=sL^2+1 family shows that the retained large-displacement mask does not give a uniform base-frequency gap. Keep varying Pell fibres in the signed survivor.

reject.reason: The target-safe t>=M^(1/4) tail leaves the exact small-t signed scalar, including the mandatory t=1 layer.
For X=N=sL^2+1 one has j=-st^2 while e(t sqrt(Ns))=e(t rho) with rho arbitrarily small on a literal retained range.
The discriminant varies with N and s, and the exact exceptional family has an unbounded next continued-fraction quotient.
The t=1 layer has C(p)=chi_4(p) for odd primes p>4 and retains only an owner-sized upper capacity; no signed estimate is proved.
C(st^2) is a t-dependent parity-sensitive strict-cone incomplete divisor fibre, not a complete fixed L-function coefficient.
The squarefree variable carries the nonlinear phase e(t sqrt(Ns)); orienting linearly in t leaves the wrong coefficient, support, and hard mask.
Even favorable separated specializations leave positive powers R^(2/5), R^(1/2), or R^(3/4), and the exact joint coefficient is not accepted.
M^(1/4+o(1)) is only the available divisor-envelope upper price; cancellation across s, t-layers, and blocks remains possible.
The small-t cone scalar, independent collar-tail cross owner, direct M1 parents, all M2 owners, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, and quarter target remain open.

no_change.reason: Round 145 strictly reduces one lower-cone survivor but proves neither its small-t signed part, the independent collar-tail cross owner, nor either direct blockwise M1 parent.
Hard TOP, BAL, and required UNBAL owners were not treated and remain open.
A support reduction for one lower-cone scalar is not an all-owner endpoint theorem.
M9-M1, M9-M2, and endpoint uniformity remain open.
The bridge remains conditional on the complete open M9 hypothesis.
The strongest internally proved global exponent remains one third.
The separately audited external exponent remains (3292+25sqrt(1717))/13762.
The quarter target still lacks the small-t lower-radial scalar, remaining M1 and M2 owners, endpoint uniformity, M9, and an unconditional final bridge.

round_assessment.reason: Round 145 proves two exact multiplicity-one coefficient parametrizations and a genuine target-safe deletion of every t>=M^(1/4) squarefree fibre, leaving the strict t<M^(1/4), s>M^(1/2) owner. It also proves a literal exceptional-frequency control and audits the first source/power failures without turning upper capacities into lower bounds. The retained signed scalar and all downstream theorems remain open.
